idea-plugin.name: Cool Theme Kit
idea-plugin.description:
The Cool Icons of Cool Theme Kit for VS Code, in PyCharm and the other JetBrains IDEs.

  • Every file and folder gets the icon the Atom Material Icons plugin gives it, drawn in the glass style of Cool Theme Kit: the glyph on the same rounded tile for files, the same rounded folder for folders.
  • The glyph is the JetBrains New UI icon where the IDE has one, the Atom Material Icons one elsewhere.
  • Files with a role show a small mark: run (main.py), package (__init__.py), test (conftest.py), settings (settings.py). They can be turned off in Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Cool Theme Kit, like roleMarks in VS Code.
  • An expanded folder shows the open folder icon, as in the VS Code explorer.
  • Source, test and resource roots and excluded folders keep the icons of the IDE.
  • An accent color for Islands Dark and Islands Light, with the presets of Cool Theme Kit for VS Code: it replaces the blue of the focus ring, buttons, links, the selected tab and the selection, with the same colors as in VS Code. It can also paint the scrollbars and badges, the tab lines and the folder icons (accentColor, accentTargets in VS Code).

Turn off the file icons of Atom Material Icons if it is installed: only one plugin can draw them.
